title: Streaming telemetry: contextual chunk metrics, structured-boundary spans, and adaptive redaction
creator: Avery Chen
description: Add contextualized per-chunk telemetry and tracing spans tied to structured-output boundaries (function/tool call start/end, JSON object boundaries) while integrating an adaptive redaction layer for streamed content. The goal is to give product and SRE teams higher-fidelity metrics (per-token and per-chunk) that are meaningful for structured outputs and tool-calling flows without leaking sensitive content into logs or traces. This ticket covers design, proto changes to chunk metadata, runtime instrumentation, sampling knobs, and a compatibility shim so older SDKs continue to map chunks to traces.
acceptance_criteria: Per-chunk metrics emitted with context tags: model, route, structured-boundary (none|func-start|func-end|json-field), call_id when available
Tracing spans created for function/tool-call boundaries and attached to the same trace id as their originating stream request
Adaptive redaction applies to logs and span attributes: PII heuristics + customer allowlist, configurable per-tenant
Backward-compat shim: chunk_id mapping table emitted for clients using legacy chunk-id scheme
Dashboards show 99th-percentile per-chunk latency split by structured-boundary and by model variant
Automated e2e test that streams a sample conversation with a function call and verifies metric tags, spans, and redaction markers
design_notes: Emit an additional field in stream chunk telemetry: structured_boundary with enum values and optional boundary_context string
Create a short-lived chunk->trace mapping in redis for 1 hour to support legacy SDKs mapping chunk ids to trace ids
Adaptive redaction runs in the streaming ingress path: lightweight regex + entropy checks + tenant allowlist; full PII detection runs asynchronously and tags for reprocessing
Sampling: default 100% for errors, 5% for success streams; configurable per-customer via Console
Avoid adding user content to span attributes; use redaction markers (redacted:true) and content hashes for debugging when allowed
implementation_notes: Runtime changes in chunk-emitter: attach structured_boundary enum and call_id when function/tool calling is detected
Tracing: open-telemetry spans created on boundary detection; ensure spans are short-lived and not containing raw content
Redaction: implement streaming redaction filter in C++ hot path to minimize overhead; fallback Java/Go implementation for control-plane ops
Compatibility shim: chunk-mapper service with HTTP endpoint and short TTL entries; migrate consumers to new chunk metadata over 2 releases
Metrics: histogram buckets tuned for sub-ms to 2s chunk durations; add labels for model_size and batching_group
tradeoffs_and_risks: Adding structured_boundary increases telemetry size and storage costs — mitigated by sampling and TTLs
On-path redaction increases CPU cost; C++ optimized path required to keep latency SLOs
Temporary complexity from chunk-mapper service and dual schema increases operational burden
PII false negatives are possible with lightweight heuristics; plan reprocessing and alerts for regression
testing_plan: Unit tests for boundary detection across tokenization edge-cases
Integration test that streams a function call (start/mid/end) and asserts spans and metric tags
Load test with synthetic workloads to verify <5% additional CPU on 95p streaming throughput
Security review and adversarial PII test corpus run against redaction heuristics
Rollout canary on internal tenant before wider release
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal canary on dev-internal for 2 weeks
Phase 2: opt-in beta for 10 pilot customers; monitor dashboards and error budgets
Phase 3: gradual default-on rollout with sampling and migration docs for SDKs
Phase 4: deprecate chunk-mapper after 2 releases and communicate to SDK authors
notes: Request from product: better insight into latency spikes when a function call is invoked midway through a stream
SRE requested chunk->trace mapping to debug misattributed logs for older clients
Design reviewed by Lila Ramos (privacy) on 2026-02-26 — recommend gating sensitive-span-attributes behind tenant flag
